 Comment React Share Sabalenka shakes up her team before WTA Finals: two key departures
 Ahead of her WTA Finals opener, Aryna Sabalenka has reportedly overhauled her staff, with Max Mirnyi and her physiotherapist no longer part of her team, according to multiple reports.
 TORONTO, CANADA - AUGUST 6: Aryna Sabalenka in action against Shui Zhang of China in the round of 32 at the National Bank Open WTA 1000 in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, on August 6, 2026. Mert Alper Dervis / Anadolu © MERT ALPER DERVIS / Anadolu via AFP Jules Hypolite 09/11/2026, 20:45 1 min to read Follow us Indian Wells Mirnyi Sabalenka WTA Finals There’s movement in Aryna Sabalenka’s camp.
 The world No. 2, who begins her campaign at the WTA Finals tonight against Karolina Muchova, has reportedly recently parted ways with two members of her staff.
 Remove ads Mirnyi no longer part of her team
 Starting with Max Mirnyi, the former world No. 1 in doubles, who joined his compatriot’s team in summer 2025 in an advisory role.
 According to information from former players Dinara Safina and Anna Chakvetadze, Mirnyi is reportedly not expected to be in Indian Wells for the WTA Finals, indicating that his collaboration with Sabalenka is over.
 Another departure confirmed
 But that’s not all, as the Belarusian has also reportedly split with her physiotherapist.
 On the sidelines of the last tournament of the season, Aryna Sabalenka has therefore decided to do a little cleaning in her team, with two departures that could allow her to revisit her ambitions in 2027.
